abilities.name: Shield Capacitor
abilities.description: Fenix has a permanent 760 Shield which regenerates at 10% per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds.; trait

abilities.name: Plasma Cutter
abilities.description: Create a laser beam at the target point that circles around Fenix twice, dealing 135 damage to enemies hit and Slowing them by 25% for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Enemies can be hit by Plasma Cutter multiple times within the same cast, but not more often than once every 0.5 seconds. Damage is dealt before any additional effects of Plasma Cutter or associated Talents are applied.

abilities.name: Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon
abilities.description: Basic Attack speed increased by 150%. Activate to change to Weapon Mode Phase Bomb, increasing Basic Attack range and damage and causing Basic Attacks to splash.

fields.notes: Repeater Cannon's single-target DPS is twice that of Phase Bomb. Switching weapon modes does not dismount nor does it interrupt mounting, hearthing or channeling objectives. Attack Speed stacks additively with other effects that can affect Fenix's Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb
abilities.description: Basic Attacks have 1.25 increased range, deal 25% more damage, and splash to nearby enemies. Activate to change to Weapon Mode Repeater Cannon, increasing Basic Attack Speed.

fields.notes: Damage bonus is implemented as a direct base damage increase, causing it to stack multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers. Switching weapon modes does not reset Fenix's auto-attack timer. The auto-attack timer ticks from its current completion percentage according to the weapon mode currently selected. Therefore, by attacking exclusively with Phase Bomb and quickly switching to Repeater Cannon and back just between auto-attacks (ideally staying in Repeater Cannon mode for all of the auto-attack downtime), Fenix can benefit from the bonus range, damage, and splash damage of Phase Bomb as well as the bonus attack speed of Repeater Cannon.

abilities.name: Warp
abilities.description: Warp to a targeted location, phasing out after 0.5 seconds, and arriving 0.75 seconds later.

fields.notes: Interrupting Warp during its cast puts it on full cooldown. While phased out Fenix is put in Stasis. However, he does not get the debuff removal most Stasis effects give.

abilities.name: Purification Salvo
abilities.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.; 90; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Mobile channel
fields.notes: 1) Scan is performed in twenty-four 7.5 degree sections rotating counter-clockwise over 1.5 seconds and only detects visible enemy Heroes. Fenix cannot attack or use his Abilities while channeling. Interrupting the Ability during the channeled targeting period puts it on a 10-second cooldown. Purification Salvo missiles can only be disjointed if the target dies, is removed from the plane (certain Stasis effects) or instantly teleports farther than 60 units from its previous location. When disjointed, the missile expires upon reaching the target's location before the event. Otherwise, the missiles will keep redirecting to the target unit. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Purification Salvo 's damage.

abilities.name: Planet Cracker
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel a powerful beam that spans across the battleground for 4 seconds, dealing 112 damage every 0.25 seconds to non-Structure enemies hit.; 100 / 1.0; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Stationary channel
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its 0.5 second windup channel puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Planet Cracker can be reactivated after 1 second to end its effect early.

talents.name: Advanced Targeting
talents.description: quest Hitting enemy Heroes with Plasma Cutter permanently increases Fenix's Basic Attack damage by 0.5, up to 60. After hitting 30 Heroes, Plasma Cutter circles an additional time.

fields.notes: Bonus damage from Advanced Targeting does not benefit from Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb 's damage multiplier.

_raw_fields: quest Hitting enemy Heroes with Plasma Cutter permanently increases Fenix's Basic Attack damage by 0.5, up to 60. After hitting 30 Heroes, Plasma Cutter circles an additional time.

talents.name: Arsenal Synergy
talents.description: After hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks 3 times while Repeater Cannon is active, the next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb deals 150% more damage and splashes in a 50% larger area.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Fenix's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: After hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks 3 times while Repeater Cannon is active, the next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb deals 150% more damage and splashes in a 50% larger area.

talents.name: Mobile Offense
talents.description: After moving, Fenix's next Basic Attack deals 35% more damage to Heroes.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Fenix's Basic Attack damage. The bonus damage vs Heroes applies to splash damage as well, even if the primary target is non-Heroic.

_raw_fields: After moving, Fenix's next Basic Attack deals 35% more damage to Heroes.

talents.name: Target Acquired
talents.description: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself, but not with other sources of Movement Speed.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

talents.name: Inhibiting Energy
talents.description: Every 10 seconds, Fenix's next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb active Slows all enemies hit by 60%, decaying in strength over 1.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Goes on full cooldown if Fenix's Basic Attack misses due to Blinds, but does not go on cooldown if it misses due to the target Evading.

_raw_fields: Every 10 seconds, Fenix's next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb active Slows all enemies hit by 60%, decaying in strength over 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Emergency Protocol
talents.description: While Fenix has shields from Shield Capacitor, he gains 10% Movement Speed. This bonus is increased to 15% when Fenix loses shields from Shield Capacitor.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other sources of Movement Speed.

_raw_fields: While Fenix has shields from Shield Capacitor, he gains 10% Movement Speed. This bonus is increased to 15% when Fenix loses shields from Shield Capacitor.

talents.name: Combat Advantage
talents.description: Plasma Cutter deals 35% more damage to Slowed targets.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Plasma Cutter 's damage.

talents.name: Warp Warfare
talents.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 175% Attack Speed for 4 seconds while in Repeater Cannon mode. Hero Takedowns reset Warp's cooldown.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with Attack Speed bonus from Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon and other effects that can affect Fenix's Attack Speed.

talents.description: Cooldown 40 Active Activate to gain 40% Basic Attack damage for 5 seconds. Basic Attacking a Hero refreshes this duration. Once Divert Power: Weapons ends, drain all of Shield Capacitor's Shields.

fields.notes: Cooldown starts ticking immediately when the Ability is cast. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Fenix's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Rapid Recharge

fields.notes: Shield healing can be increased or decreased based on Fenix's Spell Power.

talents.name: Auxiliary Shields

fields.notes: This lowers overall Fenix's effective Health pool (including Shields) by 2%. Shield gain is calculated from final damage dealt after all damage modifications.

talents.name: Offensive Cadence
talents.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against Heroes while Repeater Cannon is active deals an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health as damage.
_raw_fields: Every 3rd Basic Attack against Heroes while Repeater Cannon is active deals an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

talents.name: Photonic Weaponry
talents.description: Fenix deals 20% more damage while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

fields.notes: Affects damage dealt by both Basic Attacks and all Abilities. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Fenix's damage.

_raw_fields: Fenix deals 20% more damage while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

talents.name: Arsenal Overcharge
talents.description: Basic Attacks with Repeater Cannon reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds. Basic Attacks with Phase Bomb active reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds per Hero hit.

fields.notes: Affects both Basic and Heroic Abilities, but not Trait or Talents that have a cooldown. Repeater Cannon attacks do not require the target to be a Hero. Phase Bomb does not grant cooldown reduction for the primary target hit, even if it is a Hero. Phase Bomb attack cooldown reduction is capped at 1.5 seconds per Basic Attack (i.e. 3 Heroes).

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks with Repeater Cannon reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds. Basic Attacks with Phase Bomb active reduce Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds per Hero hit.
